title: Network Exposure Function Services; Stage 3 (NEF SBI)
tagline: NEF — expose AF session influence into the 5GC
summary: TS 29.522 defines Nnef services that allow Application Functions to influence core behaviour — including session and policy-related exposure. In the 29.512 journey, AF influence on session policy typically flows AF → PCF (29.514 Policy Authorization) with NEF as the controlled exposure path for external applications.
defines: Nnef_EventExposure — event subscription for external consumers
AF exposure into PCF/SMF policy paths
whyItMatters: Application-driven QoS and traffic influence enters the core through NEF and Policy Authorization, which can change what PCF puts in SmPolicyDecision. NEF is the exposure gate between the internet and session policy.
